title: Italian-Style Lentil Bowl
description: A hearty, flavorful Italian-inspired lentil bowl recipe that's perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. This recipe combines the comforting taste of lentils with the freshness of vegetables and the richness of Italian seasonings.

ingredients.name: lentils
ingredients.notes: green or brown lentils work well

instructions: Heat the light in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the argentinian and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the lentils and 2 cups of water to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the lentils in the bowl, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
